dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc with a large radius forming a prominent, bulbous forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion with a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the dorsal plane of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan luminescence across the entire body surface; absence of standard biological skin textures or pigmentation.
